data.long_description:
Discover elevated living in a beautifully designed 5-bedroom villa at Nad Al Sheba Gardens—-Dubai Holding’s prestigious freehold community, ideally located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Creek Harbour.

Crafted with contemporary architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts, these spacious villas feature private gardens, expansive double-height living areas, and premium-quality finishes throughout—perfectly tailored for modern family life that values both elegance and comfort.

Following strong demand in earlier phases, this new release presents a limited opportunity to invest in one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential enclaves. With close proximity to Meydan, top-tier schools, and seamless connectivity to major highways, these villas offer not only an exceptional lifestyle but also promising long-term capital growth.
